adoption_rule: User policy: operator gains above zero may be retained; other performance threshold 1%. Exact token IDs, errors and output parity required. Exclude adjacent baseline drift >3%; retain if each measured scope has positive eligible pooled gain in both screen and confirm, with at least one eligible case in every candidate round, and no full-prompt case pooled regression >2%. No repeat-until-pass. Sparse coverage remains reported; no model speedup claim.
